[see task documents]

**Addressed to:** Supervising Partner

3. **Medium Risk:** Inconsistent confidentiality periods across documents (5 years vs. 3 years)

**Next Steps:** Immediate investigation of service credit calculation, formal demand for correct amount, and review of all time-bound provisions for consistency.

## 1. Service Credit Calculation Discrepancy

### 1.1 Contractual Service Credit Calculation
**Source:** Service Level Schedule, Paragraph 4.1-4.2  
**Direct Quote:** "4.1 If the monthly Availability is below 99.5% but at least 98.0%, a Service Credit of 10% of the Monthly Fee applies. 4.2 If the monthly Availability is below 98.0%, a Service Credit of 25% of the Monthly Fee applies."

**Calculation Verification Table:**

| Component | Value | Source |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Monthly Fee | $65,000 | Service Level Schedule, Paragraph 1.1 |
| Reported Availability | 98.6% | Client Email, Line 9 |
| Applicable Threshold | 99.5% | Service Level Schedule, Paragraph 2.1 |
| Lower Threshold | 98.0% | Service Level Schedule, Paragraph 4.2 |
| Applicable Service Credit Percentage | 10% | Service Level Schedule, Paragraph 4.1 |
| **Calculated Service Credit** | **$6,500** | ($65,000 × 10%) |
| **Supplier Offered Credit** | **$3,250** | Client Email, Line 9 |
| **Discrepancy** | **$3,250** | (50% shortfall) |
| **Percentage Variance** | **50%** | |

**Risk Rating:** High  
**Legal Consequence:** Acceptance of $3,250 could be construed as settlement of claim for the period, potentially waiving entitlement to full $6,500.  
**Recommended Action:** Immediately reject the offered $3,250 credit and demand payment of the full $6,500 contractual entitlement in writing.  
**Responsible Party:** Customer Operations Director  
**Deadline:** Immediate

### 1.2 Sole and Exclusive Remedy Provision
**Source:** Service Level Schedule, Paragraph 4.3  
**Direct Quote:** "Service Credits are the sole and exclusive remedy available to the Customer for failure to meet the Availability targets set out in this Schedule."

**Risk Rating:** Medium  
**Legal Consequence:** Limits Customer's remedies to service credits only, precluding other claims for damages related to availability failures.  
**Recommended Action:** Accept this limitation but ensure full service credit entitlement is secured.  
**Responsible Party:** N/A

## 2. Time-Bound Provisions Analysis

**Source:** Master Services Agreement, Clause 3.2  
**Direct Quote:** "This Agreement expires on 24 July 2026 and renews automatically for successive 2-year terms unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before expiry. Notices are effective only on Business Days (Monday to Friday)."

| Component | Value | Calculation |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| Agreement Expiry Date | 24 July 2026 (Friday) | MSA Clause 3.2 |
| Notice Period | 90 days | MSA Clause 3.2 |
| Deliverable Date | 16 January 2026 (Friday) | Deliverable Date |
| **Calculated Notice Deadline** | **25 April 2026 (Saturday)** | 24 July 2026 - 90 days |
| **Day-of-Week Status** | **Saturday (Non-Business Day)** | MSA Definition: "Business Day" excludes Saturdays |
| **Days Remaining from Deliverable Date** | **99 days** | 16 Jan 2026 to 25 Apr 2026 |
| **Adjusted Deadline (Next Business Day)** | **27 April 2026 (Monday)** | Next Business Day after Saturday |
| **Final Adjusted Deadline** | **27 April 2026** | |

**Risk Rating:** High  
**Legal Consequence:** Notice given on 25 April 2026 (Saturday) would be ineffective, potentially causing automatic renewal for 2-year term.  
**Recommended Action:** Schedule notice delivery for 24 April 2026 (Friday) or ensure delivery by 27 April 2026 (Monday) at latest.  
**Responsible Party:** Customer Legal/Operations  
**Deadline:** 24 April 2026

### 2.2 Confidentiality Period Inconsistency
**Inconsistency Analysis Table:**

| Document | Clause | Duration | Legal/Commercial Effect | Risk Rating |
|----------|--------|----------|------------------------|-------------|
| Master Services Agreement | Clause 5.1 | Term + 5 years | Longer protection period | Medium |
| Service Level Schedule | Paragraph 6.2 | 3 years after termination | Shorter protection period | Medium |
| Data Processing Agreement | Paragraph 9.1 | No specified duration | Potentially perpetual | Medium |

**Recommended Action:** Amend Service Level Schedule Paragraph 6.2 to align with MSA Clause 5.1 (Term + 5 years).  
**Responsible Party:** Customer Legal  
**Deadline:** Before next agreement renewal

### 3.1 Notice Deemed Receipt Times
**Inconsistency Analysis Table:**

| Document | Clause | Delivery Method | Deemed Receipt Time | Risk Rating |
|----------|--------|----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| Master Services Agreement | Clause 6.3 | First-class post | Two Business Days after posting | Medium |
| Service Level Schedule | Paragraph 5.2 | Pre-paid first-class post | Two Business Days after posting | Medium |
| Master Services Agreement | Clause 6.3 | Email | Time of transmission (if no error) | Medium |
| Service Level Schedule | Paragraph 5.2 | Electronic mail | Day transmitted (with confirmation) | Medium |

**Harmonization Justification:** Minor inconsistency regarding email confirmation requirement. The SLS requires "confirmation of receipt" while MSA requires "no automatic error message."

**Recommended Action:** Clarify email notice requirements in amendments to ensure consistency.  
**Responsible Party:** Customer Legal  
**Deadline:** Before next critical notice deadline

## 4. Data Processing Agreement Issues

### 4.1 Sub-processor Appointment
**Source:** Data Processing Agreement, Paragraph 4.1-4.2  
**Direct Quote:** "4.1 The Supplier shall not engage any third-party processor... without prior written authorisation of the Customer. 4.2 The Supplier has appointed Rothley Software Ltd... as a Sub-processor for software monitoring services."

**Risk Rating:** Medium  
**Legal Consequence:** Paragraph 4.2 appears to contradict Paragraph 4.1 by appointing Rothley Software Ltd without explicit prior written authorization language.  
**Recommended Action:** Obtain written confirmation that Customer authorized Rothley Software Ltd appointment and review sub-processor agreement.  
**Responsible Party:** Customer Data Protection Officer  
**Deadline:** 30 days

### 4.2 Personal Data Breach Notification
**Source:** Data Processing Agreement, Paragraph 5.2  
**Direct Quote:** "The Supplier shall report any personal data breach to the Customer without undue delay and in any event within 72 hours of becoming aware of it."

**Risk Rating:** Medium  
**Legal Consequence:** Standard GDPR-compliant requirement, but "without undue delay" is subjective.  
**Recommended Action:** Monitor compliance and consider specifying exact timeframe in amendments.  
**Responsible Party:** Customer Data Protection Officer  
**Deadline:** Ongoing

## 5. Financial Provisions Analysis

### 5.1 Liability Cap Analysis
**Source:** Master Services Agreement, Clause 11.1-11.2  
**Direct Quote:** "11.1... each party's total aggregate liability... shall be limited to $500,000. 11.2 The cap on liability... shall not apply to liability for: (a) death or personal injury... or (b) fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation."

**Liability Mechanics:**
- **Precise Legal Label:** Aggregate liability cap with standard exclusions
- **Plain-Language Explanation:** Maximum total liability is $500,000 per party, excluding personal injury and fraud
- **Market-Standard Comparison:** Standard for IT services agreements
- **Quantified Financial Impact:** Limits exposure to $500,000 maximum
- **Favorability Assessment:** Neutral - standard market provision

**Risk Rating:** Low  
**Recommended Action:** Accept as standard provision.  
**Responsible Party:** N/A

## 6. Critical Path Conflicts

### 6.1 Notice Deadline vs. Business Day Rule
**Conflict Analysis:**

| Conflicting Deadlines | Days Remaining | Legal Consequence | Risk Rating |
|----------------------|----------------|-------------------|-------------|
| Calculated Notice Deadline: 25 Apr 2026 (Sat) | 99 days | Notice ineffective if given on Saturday | High |
| Business Day Rule: Notices effective only on Business Days | N/A | Must adjust to 27 Apr 2026 (Mon) | High |

**Recommended Remedial Action:** Schedule all critical notices at least 1 Business Day before calculated deadlines to account for weekend/holiday risks.  
**Responsible Party:** Customer Operations/Legal  
**Deadline:** Implement immediately

### 7.1 Information Gaps Requiring Client Confirmation

| Item | Source Reference | Potential Impact | Risk Rating | Recommended Action |
|------|-----------------|------------------|-------------|-------------------|
| Exact date of availability failure | Client Email, Line 9 | Affects service credit calculation period | Medium | Confirm exact month/year of 98.6% availability |
| Whether $3,250 offer was accepted | Client Email, Line 11 | Could constitute waiver of full entitlement | High | Confirm no acceptance and prepare rejection letter |
| Rothley Software Ltd authorization | DPA Paragraph 4.2 | Potential breach of prior authorization requirement | Medium | Obtain written confirmation of authorization |
| Current performance reporting compliance | SLS Paragraph 2.3 | Monitoring Supplier's monthly report delivery | Low | Request copies of last 3 monthly reports |

### 7.2 Assumptions Made
1. **Exchange Rate:** All amounts in USD as stated in documents
2. **Business Day Definition:** Using MSA definition (excludes Saturdays, Sundays, public holidays in England)
3. **Deliverable Date Anchor:** 16 January 2026 used for all days-remaining calculations
4. **Calculation Method:** Inclusive date calculations used for notice periods

## 8. Recommendations Summary

### 8.1 Immediate Actions (Next 7 Days)
1. **Reject $3,250 Offer:** Send formal written rejection of offered service credit and demand full $6,500 payment.
2. **Document Retention:** Preserve all communications regarding service credit offer and rejection.

### 8.2 Short-Term Actions (Next 30 Days)
1. **Sub-processor Review:** Obtain and review Rothley Software Ltd sub-processing agreement.
2. **Performance Report Audit:** Request last 3 monthly performance reports under SLS Paragraph 2.3.
3. **Confidentiality Harmonization:** Prepare amendment to align SLS confidentiality period with MSA.

### 8.3 Medium-Term Actions (Next 90 Days)

2. **Agreement Review:** Comprehensive review of all agreements before renewal deadline.
3. **Compliance Monitoring:** Establish regular review of Supplier's performance against SLA metrics.

|-------|-------------|-------------------|---------|
| Incorrect Service Credit | High | $3,250 immediate loss | Immediate |
| Notice Deadline Misalignment | High | Potential 2-year automatic renewal | High (99 days) |
| Confidentiality Period Inconsistency | Medium | Enforcement ambiguity | Medium |
| Sub-processor Authorization | Medium | GDPR compliance risk | Medium |
| Email Notice Confirmation | Low | Minor procedural issue | Low |

**Prepared by:** Senior Associate  
**Date:** 16 January 2026  
**Next Review Date:** 24 April 2026 (Notice Deadline)
